question: The name of the strait between the Pacific and Arctic oceans, separating the Chukchi Peninsula of the Russian Far East from the Seward Peninsula of Alaska, is the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bering Strait**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Bering Strait is a narrow passage of water that separates the Chukchi Peninsula of the Russian Far East from the Seward Peninsula of Alaska.
 
• It connects the Pacific Ocean to the Arctic Ocean, specifically linking the Bering Sea to the Chukchi Sea.
 
• The strait is named after Vitus Bering, a Danish explorer in the service of the Russian Empire, who explored the area in the early 18th century.
 
• The Bering Strait is approximately 82 kilometers (51 miles) wide at its narrowest point, with a depth of about 30-50 meters (98-164 feet).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Davis Strait**

 
 
• The Davis Strait is a northern arm of the Labrador Sea, which lies between Greenland and Canada’s Baffin Island.
 
• It is known for its harsh weather conditions and is a major route for the migration of icebergs from the Arctic Ocean.
 
 
 
• **Florida Strait**
 
 
• The Florida Strait is a strait located south-southeast of the North American mainland, generally accepted to be the boundary between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• It lies between the Gulf of Mexico and the Atlantic Ocean, separating the U.S. state of Florida from Cuba.
 
 
 
• **Messina Strait**
 
 
• The Strait of Messina is a narrow passage between the eastern tip of Sicily and the western tip of Calabria in the southern part of Italy.
 
• It connects the Tyrrhenian Sea to the north with the Ionian Sea to the south.
